name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2117: Queue item 28. The one action in this tree with no undo was the only automatic one that failed OPEN. v2082 made every spelling of off mean off and its own comment named the deeper problem without moving it: its two siblings are opt-IN, so this one alone armed itself when the variable was unset. A relaunch can be re-launched and a heal re-run; a deleted reel is gone. The retention loop measures before its first sleep, so on a tree already under the floor it acted within milliseconds of boot - and his console reports 6.6GB free against an 8GB floor right now. Announcing is unchanged; only the destruction waits for him.
